extDescription.message: Fills in the verification codes you receive by email, from your own server. Never submits anything for you.

cmdFill.message: Fill in the emailed code for this site (if auto-fill didn't happen)

keyHelp.message: Create it on the server with: codes token add <name>. You can revoke it any time with: codes token revoke <name>.

autoHelp.message: When a page shows a code field, the emailed code is typed in as soon as it arrives. Never submitted, never over what you typed.

allowAllSites.message: Allow code field detection on websites

how1.message: Nothing to do: ask the site for a code and it gets filled in when the email arrives, with an Undo button.

how2.message: Fallback: the toolbar button (code, copy, sign-in links, other recent codes) or Alt+Shift+C.

how3.message: Auto-fill only happens when the email comes from the site you are on and Gmail confirmed the sender. Otherwise the code shows in the popup with a warning. The shortcut can be changed in about:addons, gear menu, Manage Extension Shortcuts.

badServer.message: The address must start with https://

needPermission.message: Firefox has not allowed access to $1 yet: press Save and test again and accept.

keyRefused.message: The server refused this access key.

warnUnverified.message: Gmail could not confirm that this email really comes from $1.

noField.message: No field found: copy the code

waitingHelp.message: Ask the site for a code: it will show up here as soon as it arrives.

nothingReceived.message: No code received. Open the popup again to keep waiting.

notConfigured.message: Server address or access key missing.

needServerAccess.message: The extension needs permission to reach your server.
